name: git-basics
description: Curated MIT rule pack for safe, predictable Git workflows across coding agents.

rules.title: git push fails when branch has no upstream
rules.error_template: fatal: The current branch has no upstream branch
rules.fix_summary: Push feature branches with an explicit refspec `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` instead of bare `git push`.

rules.title: Rejected non-fast-forward push
rules.error_template: error: failed to push some refs: updates were rejected because the tip of your current branch is behind
rules.fix_summary: Fetch and rebase onto the updated remote branch (`git fetch origin && git rebase origin/<branch>`) before pushing; never blindly force-push shared branches.
rules.pattern_after: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/<branch>
